name: semble
description: Search a codebase the way an agent needs to — semantic and structural queries that return the relevant spans directly, cutting token use sharply versus grep-then-read loops.

skills.name: Semantic Code Search
skills.description: Finds code by meaning rather than exact string match, returning ranked spans instead of whole files.

skills.name: Local Indexing
skills.description: Builds and refreshes an on-disk index of a repository so searches run locally without sending code to a service.

skills.name: Token Efficient Output
skills.description: Returns trimmed, relevance-scoped results designed to keep agent context small on large repositories.
